Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
2.

This writ petition is preferred praying for the following principal relief:
"(i) i) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding, the Respondents for fair and impartial investigation in case crime No.514 of 2022 U/s 323, 506, 354 (kha) IPC accordance with law."
Neha Devi vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116078406/

sentences.text: It transpires from the record that fair investigation is not being conducted on account of influence exercised by the accused persons.

4. Learned AGA, on the basis of instructions, states that in the instant matter, during investigation Section 376 I.P.C. is also added and such aspects shall be examined by the second respondent, at the first instance.

5. In the facts of the case, we permit the petitioner to approach the Senior Superintendent of Police,
Varuna (Commissionerate Varanasi) highlighting her grievance, who shall call for records and will ensure that a fair and impartial investigation, in accordance with law, is got conducted and concluded, expeditiously, preferably within a period of three months from the date of presentation of a certified copy of this order.
6. With the above observations/directions, this writ petition stands disposed of.
